purpose: Teach: 船橋/府中/松村/岡部/江田/栗原/角田/板橋

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、船橋署との合同捜査をされますね
lines.en: The police will be conducting a joint investigation with Funabashi Station, then?
lines.style: Measured, slightly deferential. Checking facts rather than asking — voice rises gently at the end. Respectful distance, like confirming procedure with someone senior.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、府中署と連携した広域捜査も担当されますね
lines.en: And you'll also be handling the wider-area investigation coordinated with Fuchu Station?
lines.style: Same careful tone. Light, methodical. Adding to a list without dwelling. Steady rhythm, like going through items on a form.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人松村氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: You're taking a statement from the witness Matsumura as well?
lines.style: Slightly softer — acknowledging the human element. Still procedural, but with a hint of care. Pause before the name, like placing weight on the person.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者岡部氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: And of course, you'll be looking after the family of the victim, Okabe?
lines.style: Warmth surfaces here. 'Of course' carries understanding — not a question but acknowledgment. Slower, more deliberate. Voice settles on the family's position.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者江田氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: You've documented the witness statement from Eda?
lines.style: Back to practical. Brisk but not cold. Confirming boxes ticked. Voice is efficient without being distant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者栗原の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: And you're verifying the prior record of the suspect, Kurihara?
lines.style: Neutral, procedural. Factual — no extra weight. The kind of question that moves things forward. Steady pace, no trailing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の鑑識角田主任と現場検証されますね
lines.en: You'll be examining the scene with Tsuno, the senior forensics officer from the station?
lines.style: Slight respect creeping in — naming Tsuno with his title adds formality. Clear pace. Practical but acknowledging expertise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の板橋様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And you're scheduling the pre-trial conference with Prosecutor Itabashi as well?
lines.style: Warmer now. Almost collaborative — the sense of things working together. Gentle lift at the end. Still respectful of the prosecutor's position, but easier in tone.
